title: Local report retention cleanup
responsibility: Removes old nonreserved files and untracked run contents while preserving known runs and symlinks.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.root
inputs.description: Existing filesystem path scanned as the report store root. The root itself must not be a symbolic link; filesystem inspection errors propagate.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.cutoff
inputs.description: Finite epoch-millisecond modification-time threshold for cleanup. Non-directory entries at or before it are eligible, while newer entries are skipped.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.dryRun
inputs.description: When true, eligible non-directory entries are counted without deletion. Defaults to false; dry runs also skip removal of empty old directories.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.knownRuns
inputs.description: Set of run directory names to preserve under the root runs directory; names are compared with its entries. Defaults to new Set<string>().

outputs.name: reportLocalCleanup
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the number of eligible non-directory entries removed, or counted during a dry run. Reserved and dot-prefixed root entries are skipped, known run names are preserved, symlinks found during recursive purge contribute zero, and empty old directories are removed only outside dry runs.

errors.name: Invalid report cutoff or unsafe cleanup path
errors.description: Throws this Error for a non-finite cutoff, a symlinked root, or a symlinked root runs directory; filesystem inspection and removal errors also reject the promise.
